summary: Full testing of the new 'sondages anonymes' feature on La Bague Impériale. Backend (pytest, 8/8 passed) verified multi-question voting format, anonymity in GET responses, double-vote prevention (updates existing vote), and mon-vote endpoint. Frontend verified: Dashboard Membre (labague3) displays 'Sondages en cours' section with 'Anonyme' badge, anonymity warning, voting works, success feedback shown, and vote persists after reload. Dashboard Admin (labague1) shows 'Sondages en cours' with WhatsApp share button. /sondages admin page (after toggling Mode Président) shows Share2 WhatsApp button on each active sondage. WhatsApp URLs correctly generate wa.me links with message containing 'anonyme' and '/dashboard'. All acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py voter_sondage_generique uses bare `except:` on line ~3440-3441 which swallows all exceptions (including KeyboardInterrupt); should catch specific Exception subclass.
Dashboard.js is 3465 lines - should be split into smaller components (SondagesActifs, PaiementsEnAttente, etc.) for maintainability (>700 lines threshold).
Frontend logs show repeated 422 errors from some API calls during login/load - not blocking but should be investigated (likely unrelated to this feature).
test_credentials: labague1 (Fabien - Président admin), labague3 (Jacques Peretti - Trésorier member)
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral sondages via fixture (auto-deleted). Pre-existing test sondage 72e10e79-d634-4ae4-ba92-9b7ee43e9508 used for UI testing - Jacques voted (Gueules Noires + Oui) and vote persisted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Jacques Peretti (labague3) has already voted on sondage 72e10e79-d634-4ae4-ba92-9b7ee43e9508. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_sondages_anonymes.py is reusable (creates and cleans its own test sondages). On /sondages admin page, Share2 button only shows when Mode Président toggle is enabled (isAdmin=true).
